newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK two-year notes average accepted yield 5.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK two-year notes average accepted yield 5.58 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of two-year 5.66 percent Exchange Fund notes at Monday's tender was 5.58 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 5.78 percent and a coupon of 5.72 percent at the last tender on November 11.
Bids for Monday's HK$500 million issue totalled HK$2.87 billion against HK$2.6 billion at the previous tender.
The notes mature on February 11, 1999, the HKMA said.
